description.text: Optional workstation: place one Pattern above a vanilla Crafting Table to make a Crafting Station. This does not replace the Part Builder or Tinker Station used to make and modify tools.

Port guide: the diagram follows the source workbench tag and excludes an existing Crafting Station. Other displayed workbenches depend on current tags; this does not prove native crafting compatibility for every alternative. If the full ingredient cannot be represented, only this explanation is shown.
Existing inventory and workstation behavior remains limited; this page does not claim complete original-mod behavior or verified multiplayer operation.
